# Warp Local ACP Fork LLM Index

This repository is a fork of Warp whose maintained product surface is local terminal GUI + ACP agent + OpenAI-compatible terminal suggestions.

## Start Here

- [Repository merge guide](AGENTS.md): Fast summary of the fork delta and upstream merge decision table.
- [Agents wiki](docs/agents-wiki/README.md): Structured project wiki for future coding agents.
- [Fork contract](docs/agents-wiki/fork-contract.md): What must remain true after any change.
- [Upstream merge guide](docs/agents-wiki/upstream-merge-guide.md): How to classify upstream commits.
- [Change map](docs/agents-wiki/change-map.md): Path-level map of changed, removed, and retained areas.

## Key Code Areas

- ACP backend and protocol mapping: `app/src/ai/acp/`
- AgentView shell and ACP UI rendering: `app/src/ai/blocklist/`
- Local AI conversation model/history: `app/src/ai/agent/`, `app/src/ai/agent_conversations_model.rs`
- OpenAI-compatible suggestions: `app/src/ai/terminal_suggestions/`
- Next Command and Prompt Suggestions entrypoints: `app/src/ai/predict/terminal_input_suggestions.rs`, `app/src/ai/predict/terminal_prompt_suggestions.rs`
- AI settings: `app/src/settings/ai.rs`, `app/src/settings_view/ai_page.rs`
- Natural language input and `/agent` entry: `app/src/terminal/input.rs`, `app/src/terminal/input/agent.rs`

## Merge Classification

- Accept usually: terminal/runtime/editor/completion/platform fixes.
- Port manually: ACP, AgentView, AI settings, suggestions, persistence, local object model, remote terminal.
- Reject usually: account auth, billing, Teams, cloud Warp Drive, old Warp Agent SDK, GraphQL, managed secrets, telemetry, crash reporting, onboarding, voice input.
